patch_description: The current program creates a quadratic reward for every two-hop relay, yielding 880 terms on the n=12 examples. This version keeps the direct-link reward but limits each demanded OD pair to the best `max(1, n//5)` relays, ranked by leg affinity and relay pressure. That budget performed better than the full relay set in the reported results and keeps the interaction graph sparser. A degree penalty of 5.0 also replaces the current value of 1.0, encouraging more valid topologies before repair.
